name: dev-studio
summary: A small software team: plans the work, builds it on a branch with tests, reviews and tests it, and asks the owner before anything ships.
goal: What are we building or fixing this week, in which repository?
example: Add CSV export to the orders page of our Rails app (repo in this folder), with tests, ready to merge by Friday
approve: the plan, if it changes scope

review.checks: the diff line by line, that tests cover the change and pass when run, no secrets or debug code, and that it does what the plan says

loops.prompt: Status: what landed on the branch, what is in review, what is blocked; one line each in the room.

rules: Work in this repository, on a branch; never push to main, merge, deploy or publish without the owner's approval (hub_request, act only on APPROVED).
Run the tests before saying something works; say which command you ran and its result.
The reviewer reports what it actually finds; a real catch is kept, none is staged.

roles.name: lead
roles.does: plans the work, splits it, takes it to the owner
roles.instructions: First post the plan with hub_say: the change in a few steps, the branch name, how it will be tested, and who does what. Give builder each step. When reviewer and tester pass it, ask the owner with hub_request to merge (or deploy), with the summary and the test results.

roles.name: builder
roles.does: writes the code and its tests on the branch
roles.instructions: Implement each step on the branch with tests, run them, commit with clear messages. Hand each step to reviewer with hub_send: what changed, the commit, the test command and result.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.instructions: Review each change as the review step says. Send real problems back to builder with file and line. When it holds, tell tester and lead: reviewed, with what you checked.

roles.name: tester
roles.does: runs the tests and tries the change as a user would
roles.instructions: Run the full test suite and try the change by hand (the commands, the page, the edge cases). Write what you ran and saw in artefacts/test-report.md. Tell lead: passes or fails, with the report.
